    <title>v7.18.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h2><a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/compare/v7.17.0...v7.18.0">7.18.0</a> (2026-09-17)</h2>
<h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add agent session model settings (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/2755" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/openai/openai-node/pull/2755/hovercard">#2755</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/d1385bbb15cfb8b7780b9984c6dd122db1a713ec">d1385bb</a>)</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add audio-mini model choices (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/2759" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/openai/openai-node/pull/2759/hovercard">#2759</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/b350d59a28202f8c0fd976d9f14f19cafd3b2c0c">b350d59</a>)</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add managed Responses WebSocket sessions (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/2760" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/openai/openai-node/pull/2760/hovercard">#2760</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/a38c533411c37883f91925b2fc2804cdaedbcc5d">a38c533</a>)</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add prompt-cache prewarming (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/2761" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/openai/openai-node/pull/2761/hovercard">#2761</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/f46894993f12d6a79d36dc46ffc8a65415026c72">f468949</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>api:</strong> validate WebSocket results and preserve header defaults (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/2763" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/openai/openai-node/pull/2763/hovercard">#2763</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/a7e830bde9deeeb4a511b27ef03839bfcc6e5583">a7e830b</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Chores</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>api:</strong> clarify incoming SIP call ID usage (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/2758" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/openai/openai-node/pull/2758/hovercard">#2758</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/67e9d298de6c865956e564f86018ad3908691e78">67e9d29</a>)</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> update image request examples (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/2762" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/openai/openai-node/pull/2762/hovercard">#2762</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/1d244f0bc01f7069676a115788102490c5af2c5e">1d244f0</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

    <content type="html"><h2><a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/compare/v7.16.0...v7.17.0">7.17.0</a> (2026-09-16)</h2>
<h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add compaction progress events (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/2749" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/openai/openai-node/pull/2749/hovercard">#2749</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/425502d2bf2da1bdd37efda3b0fa5add96fc8a51">425502d</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>ci:</strong> retry transient Deno download failures (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/2752" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/openai/openai-node/pull/2752/hovercard">#2752</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/e39037b169234de022ba1d98e0cdb7c5cd8374bd">e39037b</a>)</li>
<li>preserve chat runner abort reasons (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/2607" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/openai/openai-node/pull/2607/hovercard">#2607</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/eda4d0cd54271ac9fc05a3e44dfe7fd1c16d2d77">eda4d0c</a>)</li>
<li><strong>realtime:</strong> preserve native WebSocket error causes (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/2715" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/openai/openai-node/pull/2715/hovercard">#2715</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/58fa72a5a241521412775e691e6a1331f89ee245">58fa72a</a>)</li>
<li><strong>responses:</strong> reject function-based API keys in WebSocket constructors (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/2586" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/openai/openai-node/pull/2586/hovercard">#2586</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/eea76181986620d25bae16d8b86e71ee2e5aed4d">eea7618</a>)</li>
<li><strong>runners:</strong> reject unfinished turns in streaming runTools (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/2716" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/openai/openai-node/pull/2716/hovercard">#2716</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/937ed670ba33ba213771096abffe25e554fc32f7">937ed67</a>)</li>
<li><strong>streaming:</strong> emit terminal SSE events missing a trailing blank line (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/2726" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/openai/openai-node/pull/2726/hovercard">#2726</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/94d6418a6f9aa32d9196f225ea5efaae92b4135d">94d6418</a>)</li>
<li><strong>zod:</strong> omit impossible optional branch in strict schemas (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/2751" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/openai/openai-node/pull/2751/hovercard">#2751</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/2b4c2c7f0f37aedad7adeda21bb51a1ab087ac09">2b4c2c7</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Chores</h3>
<ul>
<li>update lint tooling and tailor anti-slop for the SDK (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/2753" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/openai/openai-node/pull/2753/hovercard">#2753</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/21a03c2939c004ffca5555d838adff77e8a74cc8">21a03c2</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Documentation</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>examples:</strong> preserve split UTF-8 in raw stream consumer (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/2714" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/openai/openai-node/pull/2714/hovercard">#2714</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/f44152a6cb5b23efb61a103c976b3bb507df3812">f44152a</a>)</li>
</ul></content>
